properties.definition: Technical antecedents and missing context never produce a legal verdict.
properties.positiveCase: Matched antecedent emits REVIEW_REQUIRED with missingEvidence.
properties.counterexample: Missing legal context emits reassurance or a legal verdict.
properties.testEvidence: must not emit a reassuring no-concern result

properties.definition: Invalid source, number, time, predicate, graph, pack, or snapshot is rejected.
properties.counterexample: An unsupported source is normalised and evaluated.

properties.definition: Synthetic evidence cannot become observed-real accumulation.
properties.positiveCase: Controlled evidence retains its label and source.
properties.counterexample: Synthetic history completes a native-observation combination.

properties.definition: An identical deduplication identity does not increase cumulative evidence.
properties.positiveCase: Repeated identity leaves the ledger result unchanged.
properties.counterexample: Exact replay increments a rolling total.

properties.definition: All valid permutations of an unordered declared multiset have identical match semantics.
Overlapping aggregate windows are not summed without independence evidence.
A valid same-pack in-window snapshot resumes with the uninterrupted result.
Stored findings retain the producing pack identifier and version.
properties.positiveCase: Pack switch leaves historical identity unchanged.
properties.counterexample: Opening history silently applies the active pack.

properties.definition: Timeout, failure, and no artifact remain missing outcomes, not negatives.
